MIND. [1] [Aster.]
Loss of consciousness. θ Epilepsy.
Does not lose consciousness but has hallucinations-as if away from home in midst of strangers ; hears voices to which he replies. θ Epilepsy.
Unwilling to work, to think ; is indifferent ; dull headache ; insensible, does not know if he has taken his dinner ; returns in morning on getting up, 9th day.
Feeling of extreme anxiety from noon to 3 P. M.
It seems as if some misfortune was impending, as if bad news was about to arrive-tears afford relief. θ Hysteria.
Became very impatient. θ Precursor of apoplexy.
Paroxysms easily excited by any emotion, especially by contradiction. θ Epilepsy.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Aster.]
Vertigo : transitory ; when walking, with insensibility of lower limbs.
Sudden attacks of vertigo like shocks in head. θ Precursor of apoplexy.
Wakes at night with sensation as if brain was shaken by electric shocks ; head seems empty, almost deprived of consciousness ; thinks he is attacked by apoplexy, lasts several minutes ; when he recovers his consciousness, pulse hard.
Since two years he lost consciousness with the attacks. θ Epilepsy.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Aster.]
Heat of head, as if surrounded by hot air.
Sanguineous congestion to brain. θ Precursor of apoplexy.
Awakes at night in distress as from electric shocks in brain ; head feels as if bursting ; apprehended apoplexy ; when he came to himself pulse was hard, very quick, and right carotid throbbing violently.
Cerebral congestions, accompanied by obstinate constipation.
A violent pressure upon anterior lobes of brain, extending even beneath eyes ; one day so severe that while seated at table she fell forward, and remained unconscious for some minutes. θ Epilepsy.
Dull occipital headache for a half hour, came suddenly one and a half hours after breakfast, and went suddenly.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Aster.]
Head burning. θ Precursor of apoplexy.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Aster.]
Violent pressure upon anterior lobes of brain, extending beneath eyes. θ Epilepsy.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Aster.]
Face red, pulse hard, compressed, frequent. θ Precursor of apoplexy.
Redness of face. θ Threatened apoplexy.
Pallor of face. θ Epilepsy.
Earthy appearance of face. θ Cancer mamma.
Her face was pale and her jaws set while unconscious. θ Epilepsy.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Aster.]
Want of appetite, no taste. θ Scirrhus.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Aster.]
The paroxysms occur at commencement of last meal of day. θ Epilepsy.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Aster.]
Great debility with distress in epigastrium. θ Epilepsy.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Aster.]
Sensation of pressure on lower abdominal organs impeding locomotion. θ Uterine displacement.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Aster.]
Obstinate constipation ; twelve to fifteen days elapsed without an evacuation, which consisted, when it occurred, of very hard, round substances about the size of an olive. θ Precursor of apoplexy.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Aster.]
Menses are apt to delay. θ Hysteralgia.
General feeling of distress in womb as though something was passing out. θ Hysteralgia. θ Displaced uterus.
Jerking in uterus. θ Hysteralgia.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Aster.]
Lancinating or acute smarting pains in mammary tumor entirely deprived her of rest, especially at night. θ Scirrhus.
Drawing pain in breast. θ Cancer.
Left breast feels drawn in. θ Cancer.
Around nipple, which was sunk into a cavity, skin smooth and adherent ; upon one point of this surface a violet spot, indicating fungus hematodes. θ Cancer of mamma.
Ulceration and swelling in left breast ; sharp stitching pain going through to back.
Breasts swollen, distended as before menses. θ Cancer.
Induration of left mamma, size of head of infant ; almost insensible, very hard and angular. θ Cancer mamma.
A scirrhous tumor forms in right mamma, adhering by its entire base to thoracic walls. θ Scirrhus.
A livid red spot appeared upon one point of tumor, broke and gave exit to a discharge of blood ; gradually invaded whole breast, eight inches in circumference, discharging very fetid ichor ; edges sensitive, pale, elevated, mamillary, hard, everted ; bottom covered with reddish granulations. θ Scirrhus.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Aster.]
Drawing pain towards internal part of chest from before backward, extending under left nipple into whole internal part of arm to extremity of little finger.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Aster.]
Pulse hard, compressed and frequent. θ Apoplexy.
Hard, frequent and contracted pulse.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Aster.]
Whole left side of chest is painful ; motion < the pain.
Drawing pain towards internal part of chest, from before backward, extending under left nipple into whole internal part of arm to extremity of little finger.
Sternal integument swollen and painful. θ Scirrhus.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Aster.]
Scrofulous ulcer on left side of neck, about two inches broad, extending from border of hair to clavicle, edges hard and elevated.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Aster.]
Axillary glands swollen, hard and knobbed ; Knotted cords from right mamma to spine. θ Scirrhous mamma.
Painful drawing in muscles of right upper arm.
Drawing pain towards inner portion of chest from before backward ; under left breast this pain extends under whole inner portion of arm to end of little finger.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Aster.]
During day annoyed by permanent contractions of muscles of lower limbs ; during night great agitation and little sleep. θ Precursor of apoplexy.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Aster.]
With attacks convulsive motions of limbs. θ Epilepsy.
Pains in limbs.
Laming pains in whole right side at night.
Starting in upper and lower limbs, continuing several days.
   

REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Aster.]
Gait unsteady ; muscles refuse to obey efforts of will.
   

NERVES. [36] [Aster.]
General malaise ; lassitude ; feels better after eating.
Convulsive motions of limbs during unconsciousness.
Twitching over whole body four or five days before attack. θ Epilepsy.
Weak and pale. θ Epilepsy.
Sudden falling ; livid face, convulsive motion of jaws, froth at mouth, convulsive shocks in limbs, loss of consciousness. θ Epilepsy.
Convulsive movements of jaws, froth at mouth. θ Epilepsy.
After attacks great debility with a sense of distress in epigastrium. θ Epilepsy.
Convulsive attacks, after pressing pain in forepart of head and over eyes, with falling forward, loss of consciousness, trismus, pale face, convulsive motions of limbs.
Epilepsy.
Lameness of limbs.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Aster.]
Awakes in night with great distress and confusion ; it seems to him as if brain were shaken by electric shocks.
Nocturnal lancinating pain in tumor. θ Cancer mamma.
During night great agitation and little sleep. θ Precursor of apoplexy.
Cannot sleep from pain in mammary cancer.
   

TEMPERATURE AND WEATHER. [39] [Aster.]
Complaints < in cold, damp weather.
   

FEVER. [40] [Aster.]
Increased general heat.
   

ATTACKS, PERIODICITY. [41] [Aster.]
Attacks gradually lessened to shorter intervals. θ Epilepsy.
   

SKIN. [46] [Aster.]
Scrofulous ulcer left side of throat.
Itch.
Tetters.
Sensitive edges, fetid discharge. θ Cancer mamma.
Dry, harsh skin, earthy appearance. θ Cancer mamma.
Skin destitute of pliability and elasticity. θ Ulcer on neck.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Aster.]
Sycosis.
Girl, æt. 22, delicate, lymphatic and very irritable temperament ; epilepsy.
Woman, æt. 48, flabby, lymphatic constitution, for several years a scrofulous ulcer.
Man, æt. 56, plethoric constitution, sedentary since eight years ; epilepsy.
A woman, æt. 56, dry constitution ; scirrhus in breast.
Woman, æt. 60, strong constitution ; induration of left mamma.
A man, æt. 74, nervous, sanguine, suffering hardships of war as an officer, particularly during campaign in Egypt ; threatened apoplexy.
